Command-line reference

Every command and option of DocWiz.exe. This page is a documentation package: a self-contained website that the handover shows in its own tab, the way a generated API reference would be shipped. For task-oriented recipes, see the chapter The command line in the manual.

Usage

DocWiz.exe <command> <arguments> [options] | Out-Host
  • Arguments and options must appear in the order shown on this page.
  • DocWiz.exe is a Windows program: in scripts, pipe its output (for example | Out-Host in PowerShell) so the script waits for it and receives its exit code.
  • Without a command, DocWiz.exe opens the editor — the same as double-clicking it.
  • A command DocWiz doesn't recognize prints the list of commands.

Exit codes

CodeMeaning
0Success. For check and build, warnings alone still give 0.
1Failure: validation errors, a missing project, or a failed export.
2The command or its options were not understood; the list of commands was printed.

edit

DocWiz.exe edit [<project-folder>] [--port <n>] [--no-browser]

Starts the editor. Without a folder it opens the welcome screen. An empty folder is turned into a new blank project first.

OptionMeaning
--port <n>The local port of the editor. Default 5210. If DocWiz is already running on that port, the running editor is opened instead.
--no-browserStart the editor without opening a window — open http://127.0.0.1:<port> yourself.

new

DocWiz.exe new <folder> [--template <id>]

Creates a new project in an empty or new folder.

OptionMeaning
--template blankOne introduction chapter and a user-training deck (the default).
--template software-handbookOverview, installation, operations, troubleshooting and integration chapters with three outputs.

The templates shown on the editor's welcome screen are not available here; start those from the editor.

check

DocWiz.exe check <project-folder>

Validates the project and prints every error and warning, errors first, followed by a summary line such as DW-GUIDE: 25 chapters, 4 views — 0 error(s), 0 warning(s). Exits 1 when there are errors.

build

DocWiz.exe build <project-folder> [-o <out-dir>] [--zip]

Checks the project and, when there are no errors, builds the handover.

OptionMeaning
-o <out-dir>Where to write the handover. Default <project>\output\handover. The folder is deleted and rewritten.
--zipAlso packs the handover as <code>-v<version>.zip in the parent of the output folder.

export-pdf

DocWiz.exe export-pdf <project-folder> [-o <dir>] [--all]

Exports the manual as PDF using Microsoft Edge. Each file is reported as OK or FAIL; the exit code is 0 only if all succeeded.

OptionMeaning
-o <dir>Output folder. Default <project>\output\PDF_Export. It may not be inside the handover folder.
--allAlso export every slide deck and document.

Exporting single chapters, or exporting as single HTML files, is done from the editor.

export-view

DocWiz.exe export-view <project-folder> <view-id> [-o <file.html>]

Exports one slide deck or document as a single, self-contained HTML file. The view id is the output's file name in the views folder without .yaml, for example quick-reference. Default output: <project>\output\<view-id>.html.

draft-view

DocWiz.exe draft-view <project-folder> <chapter-id> [-o <file.yaml>]

Drafts a slide deck from one chapter: a section-header slide from the chapter title, then one slide per section, each linked to the manual. Writes views\<chapter-id>-deck.yaml (never overwriting an existing file) and then runs check.

import-docx

DocWiz.exe import-docx <file.docx> <project-folder> --section <folder> [--discipline <d>]

Imports every section of a Word document as chapters into the section folder <folder> under content (created if needed), and prints a list of anything to review. Needs the pandoc folder next to DocWiz.exe.

OptionMeaning
--section <folder>The section folder, for example "040-Imported".
--discipline <d>Optional label recorded in each chapter's header.

convert-emf

DocWiz.exe convert-emf <project-folder>

Converts Word vector pictures (EMF, WMF) to PNG and updates the links to them. The originals are moved to _emf-originals, which is never shipped.
